summary: Only a core the installer placed in a managed data root (one holding a current entry), at <version>/bin/concord or .concord-transactions/<id>/stage/version/bin/concord, opens, migrates, plans, backs up into, verifies, restores into, or recovers a store whose directory is that root; any other binary, including a build in a managed worktree, refuses before touching the store, leases, locks, or fences, whatever its version stamp, and names the installed release and the isolation route.
title: A binary the installer did not place never opens the installed store
